# monotaur_business_hours (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur business-hours schedule by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_business_hours" "office" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the business hours to look up.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the business hours were created.
- `days_of_week` (Set of String) The days the time range applies to, as individual day names (`Sunday` … `Saturday`).
- `end_time` (String) When the range ends, as a .NET TimeSpan; earlier than `start_time` means it ends the following day, `1.00:00:00` means midnight.
- `name` (String) The name of the business hours.
- `start_time` (String) When the range starts each day, as a .NET TimeSpan (`hh:mm:ss`).
- `time_zone_id` (String) The IANA or Windows time zone the times follow; null means UTC.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the business hours were last updated.
